report_markdown:
**Quillforge — week of Nov 10 to 16, 2026.** 5 first-hand App Store reviews read (the feed was supplied in place of a fetch; the web was unreachable this run, so HN and Reddit were not read). Ranked by volume first: billing 3 posts against sync 1, with sync kept high on severity because it describes data loss.

**1. Unannounced price rise from $4 to $6 — new, high severity, 3 of 5 reviews (Nov 10–14).** Users say they were charged the higher rate with no notice; one is cancelling. "Subscription price went from $4 to $6 with no notice." (Nov 13) · "Charged $6 after the $4 plan I signed up for. Where is the notice?" (Nov 12) · "Price hike without warning. Cancelling." (Nov 11). No vendor response seen. No release tie: version link unconfirmed.

**2. Notes still lost on sync after 4.2.1 — continuing, high severity, 1 of 5 reviews.** A single post, counted on the data-loss rule rather than volume. "Still losing notes on sync. 4.2.1 did not fix it." (Nov 14). This is the same problem reported last week against 4.2; the fix update did not resolve it for this user.

**What is new:** the billing complaint is this week's largest theme and did not appear last week. Sync loss continues. One 5-star review praising widgets was the week's only praise and is too few to form a theme.

**Not read:** Hacker News and Reddit were not reachable from this run.
